Struct GOPSettings

Namespace
FFmpeg.Codecs.Video.LibSVTAV1

Represents the Group of Pictures (GOP) settings, controlling the interval between keyframes in video encoding.

Properties

AsTimeSpan

Gets or sets the GOP size as a TimeSpan, representing the duration between keyframes in seconds.
When set, the Frames property is automatically adjusted to reflect the equivalent number of seconds.

public TimeSpan? AsTimeSpan { readonly get; set; }

Property Value

TimeSpan?

Frames

Gets or sets the GOP size in frames. Accepts values from [-2 to (2^31)-1].
Special values:

  • -2: Approximately 5 seconds (default)
  • -1: Infinite GOP size, only applicable in CRF mode
  • 0: Equivalent to -1

In SvtAv1EncApp, you can append the 's' suffix to use seconds instead of frames. To set GOP size in seconds directly, use AsTimeSpan. 
public int? Frames { readonly get; set; }

Property Value

int?

IsTimeSpan

Indicates whether the GOP size is in seconds or frames.
True if AsTimeSpan was used to set the value; false if Frames was used.

public readonly bool IsTimeSpan { get; }

Property Value

bool

SceneChangeDetection

Controls whether scene change detection is enabled.
When enabled, the encoder inserts keyframes at scene changes to enhance visual quality.
Default is false.

public bool? SceneChangeDetection { readonly get; set; }

Property Value

bool?
